Agent Name: FileSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: FileSurfer failed to provide accurate word count information for "The Lost Symbol." Instead of sourcing the correct word count from reliable data, FileSurfer instructed to assume a word count of approximately 160,000 words, which may not reflect the actual word count of the book. This assumption led to an incorrect calculation of the reading speed and subsequently resulted in the wrong identification of the slowest read book.
